::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Incise Infotech Limited (incorporated 2010, registered in Delhi; offices in Noida and Bengaluru). Mainly a design-services and IP firm; its own product is the INC2106 linear LED driver IC, the smallest PDLI project by outlay (₹4.28 crore).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Semiconductor design services and verification IP, plus its INC2106 linear LED driver IC.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 2/5:** Linear LED driver IC; simple power analog.
- **IP ownership 2/5:** Mainly a design-services and verification-IP firm; INC2106 is its only own chip.
- **Design completeness 2/5:** INC2106 LED driver is the DLI project; no tape-out reported.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** No product shipments reported; smallest PDLI outlay at Rs 4.28 crore.
